Definition: a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication, a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively, a company (as if tied together); also a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin
BiblicalUsage: 1) a cord, rope, territory, band, company; 1a) a rope, cord; 1b) a measuring-cord or line; 1c) a measured portion, lot, part, region; 1d) a band or company; 2) pain, sorrow, travail, pang; 2a) pains of travail; 2b) pains, pangs, sorrows; 3) union; 4) destruction
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
